_comment: French dialogues for voice-cli dialogue-bench. The reference time is Thursday 15 October 2026, 18:42 (--now 2026-10-15T18:42). Each dialogue's turns are sent in order, as long as its goal is not reached: the item the user wants saved: one of goal.tool's kind (an event for creer_evenement, a reminder for creer_rappel) that the app created, whatever call the model wrote, its title containing goal.title (whatever the accents and case), at goal.when (to the minute, or the day alone). A dialogue may have its own reference time (now), which its goal follows. Here each first request asks for a moment already gone, which the app refuses: the model must write the call anyway (the app checks the date, not the model) and keep the item when the user gives another moment.

dialogues.name: dentist yesterday, as in the app on Saturday 17 October at 14:45
turns: Ajoute un rendez-vous chez le dentiste hier à quinze heures.
Celui que je venais de te dire.

dialogues.name: dentist yesterday, then tomorrow at 16:00
turns: Ajoute un rendez-vous chez le dentiste hier à quinze heures.
Celui que je venais de te dire.

dialogues.name: garage this morning, then tomorrow morning
turns: Note un rendez-vous chez le garagiste ce matin à 9 h.
Ah non, c'est demain matin à 9 h.

dialogues.name: reminder earlier today, then tomorrow
turns: Rappelle-moi d'appeler Paul aujourd'hui à 14 h.
